notes.note: Error of GET /findings/{id}: no finding with this identifier, or none the person may read.
Error of the findings routes on a server that does not run the findings index.

segment.source: The findings are not available on this server.
segment.target: Fynden är inte tillgängliga på den här servern.

notes.note: Low disk space at the hour's rate: the time until the store takes no new data, the headroom lost an hour, and the free space of the store's file system, each with its unit.

segment.source: At the last hour's rate, {rate} an hour, changes are refused in about {left}. {free} free.
segment.target: Med den senaste timmens takt, {rate} i timmen, avvisas ändringar om cirka {left}. {free} ledigt.

notes.note: Low disk space at the day's rate: the time until the store takes no new data, the headroom lost a day, and the free space of the store's file system, each with its unit.

segment.source: At the last day's rate, {rate} a day, changes are refused in about {left}. {free} free.
segment.target: Med det senaste dygnets takt, {rate} per dygn, avvisas ändringar om cirka {left}. {free} ledigt.

notes.note: Low disk space just above the store's margin: the free space and the margin the store keeps, with units.

segment.source: Only {free} free, just above the {margin} the store keeps free: below that line, changes are refused.
segment.target: Bara {free} ledigt, strax över de {margin} som lagret håller fritt: under den gränsen avvisas ändringar.

notes.note: Low disk space by the level of the file system: the free space of the data directory's file system and its size, with units.

segment.source: The data directory has {free} of {total} free.

notes.note: What to do about a disk short of room, after its sentence: no page frees disk space.

segment.source: Free space outside Tenko's store: the system journal, backups (move them to another disk), and copies under upgrade-backups/ of versions you will not go back to. Never delete anything under store/.
segment.target: Frigör utrymme utanför Tenkos lager: systemjournalen, säkerhetskopior (flytta dem till en annan disk) och kopior under upgrade-backups/ av versioner du inte tänker gå tillbaka till. Ta aldrig bort något under store/.
